sources.entry: Fluidd - Lightweight & responsive user interface for Klipper, the 3D printer firmware. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 Docker/Nodejs

summary.one_liner: Fluidd is a free, open-source, lightweight web interface for Klipper, the 3D printer firmware, used to manage and monitor 3D printers.
summary.what_it_does: Fluidd is a browser-based user interface for Klipper 3D printer firmware. The README describes a responsive UI that works on desktop, tablet, and mobile. Panels in the layout can be moved and customized, and built-in color themes are included. A single Fluidd install can manage multiple printers. The README points to external docs and a Discord for installation and configuration help. It also states that an official Docker image (serving on port 80) and an unprivileged Docker image (serving on port 8080) are published and updated with each release and commit.
use_cases: control a Klipper 3D printer from a web browser
monitor multiple 3D printers from one dashboard
run a printer web UI on a phone or tablet
deploy a printer web interface in Docker
run a rootless unprivileged printer UI container
how_to_run: Install via KIAUH together with Klipper, Moonraker, and dependencies (per README)
Or pull the official Docker image (serves on port 80)
Or pull the unprivileged Docker image (serves on port 8080)
Download the latest release from the releases link in the README
notable: Installs alongside Klipper and Moonraker via the KIAUH installer
Official Docker image plus a separate unprivileged Docker variant
Manages multiple printers from one install
caveats: Requires an existing Klipper and Moonraker setup; it is a front end for them
Installation and configuration details are only in external docs, not the README
